relationships.label: Arabic commentary on Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim
relationships.evidence: al-Nawawī's al-Minhāj is an explicit commentary on Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim; this does not authenticate every report or align edition-independent numbers.

relationships.label: Commentary on the Alfiyya
relationships.evidence: The Qatar Digital Library identifies the 1885 printed Sharḥ Ibn ʿAqīl as a commentary on Ibn Mālik's Alfiyya.

relationships.label: Abridgment of the rhetoric section (part III)
relationships.evidence: The Princeton manuscript catalogue explicitly identifies al-Qazwīnī's Talkhīṣ as an abridgment of the third part of al-Sakkākī's Miftāḥ, not of the entire work.

relationships.label: Author's explanatory expansion
relationships.evidence: Princeton's catalogue identifies al-Īḍāḥ as based on al-Qazwīnī's own Talkhīṣ, in the manner of a commentary, with material from al-Sakkākī and al-Jurjānī.

relationships.label: Short commentary on the Talkhīṣ
relationships.evidence: The IRCICA catalogue identifies Taftāzānī's Mukhtaṣar al-maʿānī as a commentary on al-Qazwīnī's Talkhīṣ al-Miftāḥ.
